note: Custom story roles; not a statement of canonical character alignment. Creature actions/narration must not be sent to character TTS.

Adept Blue Wizard.spoken_text: The last climber cracked a ward. I won't let the next one finish the job.
Adept Blue Wizard.choice_text: The last climber cracked a ward. I won't let the next one finish the job.

Adept Red Wizard.spoken_text: My master needs the Heart Shard. I need my master's favour. You understand.
Adept Red Wizard.choice_text: My master needs the Heart Shard. I need my master's favour. You understand.

Ancient Vampire.spoken_text: My freedom lies beyond one final bargain: no climber passes. You understand my difficulty.
Ancient Vampire.choice_text: My freedom lies beyond one final bargain: no climber passes. You understand my difficulty.

Bear.sound_direction: A deep growl; it blocks the narrow approach to its den.
Bear.narrator_caption: The path runs too close to its cubs.
Bear.choice_text: A deep growl; it blocks the narrow approach to its den.

Bird.sound_direction: Sharp alarm calls from the nest above the passage.
Bird.narrator_caption: A frightened parent guarding its eggs.
Bird.choice_text: Sharp alarm calls from the nest above the passage.

Chandra.spoken_text: I tried waiting for the tower to let us go. It won't. Stand aside before I burn a way out.
Chandra.choice_text: I tried waiting for the tower to let us go. It won't. Stand aside before I burn a way out.

Chandra's Pyromancer.spoken_text: My mistress burned her way up these stairs. Nobody else gets to follow her!
Chandra's Pyromancer.choice_text: My mistress burned her way up these stairs. Nobody else gets to follow her!

Dinosaur.sound_direction: Heavy stamping, followed by a short defensive roar.
Dinosaur.narrator_caption: You have entered its nesting grounds.
Dinosaur.choice_text: Heavy stamping, followed by a short defensive roar.

Dinosaur Elite.sound_direction: A powerful challenge roar; the herd gathers behind it.
Dinosaur Elite.narrator_caption: The herd cannot retreat from this stolen jungle.
Dinosaur Elite.choice_text: A powerful challenge roar; the herd gathers behind it.

Dog.sound_direction: A low warning growl; it steps between you and its shelter.
Dog.narrator_caption: It is protecting the only home it has left.
Dog.choice_text: A low warning growl; it steps between you and its shelter.

Elf.spoken_text: Our forest was torn from its world, but it is still our forest. Walk around it, climber.
Elf.choice_text: Our forest was torn from its world, but it is still our forest. Walk around it, climber.

Emrakul.sound_direction: The air fractures into an impossible sub-bass groan and whisperless spectral tearing.
Emrakul.narrator_caption: The devourer has sensed the shard you carry.
Emrakul.choice_text: The air fractures into an impossible sub-bass groan and whisperless spectral tearing.

Esper Artificer.spoken_text: Perfection needs a power source. Your shard will run my workshop for a thousand years.
Esper Artificer.choice_text: Perfection needs a power source. Your shard will run my workshop for a thousand years.

Ghalta.sound_direction: An immense chest-deep roar; trees shake along the jungle passage.
Ghalta.narrator_caption: The jungle ruler sees an intruder approaching its herd.
Ghalta.choice_text: An immense chest-deep roar; trees shake along the jungle passage.

Goblin.spoken_text: Shiny shard? Mine now! Finders keepers - the tower said so!
Goblin.choice_text: Shiny shard? Mine now! Finders keepers - the tower said so!

Goblin Artificer.spoken_text: Your shard would make a lovely power core. Hold still while I take it apart.
Goblin Artificer.choice_text: Your shard would make a lovely power core. Hold still while I take it apart.

Goblin Chief.spoken_text: Big boss of all the goblins wants the big shiny shard. Big boss gets what big boss wants!
Goblin Chief.choice_text: Big boss of all the goblins wants the big shiny shard. Big boss gets what big boss wants!

Goblin King.spoken_text: A king needs a crown! That shard would look great on mine. Get 'em, lads!
Goblin King.choice_text: A king needs a crown! That shard would look great on mine. Get 'em, lads!

Griffin.sound_direction: A shrill territorial cry; broad wings close over the ledge.
Griffin.narrator_caption: Its nesting ledge is the only way forward.
Griffin.choice_text: A shrill territorial cry; broad wings close over the ledge.

Guardian Angel.spoken_text: I will not risk the worlds below for one world above. Turn back, and I will let you leave.
Guardian Angel.choice_text: I will not risk the worlds below for one world above. Turn back, and I will let you leave.

High Elf.spoken_text: Our grove is held within these walls. I will not let you tear it apart to save your own.
High Elf.choice_text: Our grove is held within these walls. I will not let you tear it apart to save your own.

Illusionist.spoken_text: Is this the stair you climbed? Is that your shard? Nothing up here is what it seems... least of all you.
Illusionist.choice_text: Is this the stair you climbed? Is that your shard? Nothing up here is what it seems... least of all you.

Kor Warrior.spoken_text: My people trusted us with this seal. I cannot gamble their lives on a stranger's promise.
Kor Warrior.choice_text: My people trusted us with this seal. I cannot gamble their lives on a stranger's promise.

Lathliss.spoken_text: My brood cannot leave while the wards stand. The tower offered one bargain; I will see it kept.
Lathliss.choice_text: My brood cannot leave while the wards stand. The tower offered one bargain; I will see it kept.

Master Black Wizard.spoken_text: Death is no obstacle in the Spire - only a delay. I will take your shard and your soul.
Master Black Wizard.choice_text: Death is no obstacle in the Spire - only a delay. I will take your shard and your soul.

Master Blue Wizard.spoken_text: Your shard is tied to the wards. I cannot allow its removal until I know what it will undo.
Master Blue Wizard.choice_text: Your shard is tied to the wards. I cannot allow its removal until I know what it will undo.

Master Green Wizard.spoken_text: Nature mends what is broken. The Spire is wounded - and you are one more wound.
Master Green Wizard.choice_text: Nature mends what is broken. The Spire is wounded - and you are one more wound.

Master Red Wizard.spoken_text: Power belongs to those bold enough to seize it. Today, that is not you.
Master Red Wizard.choice_text: Power belongs to those bold enough to seize it. Today, that is not you.

Master White Wizard.spoken_text: Bring proof that the seal can survive your ascent. Until then, I must bar the way.
Master White Wizard.choice_text: Bring proof that the seal can survive your ascent. Until then, I must bar the way.

Merfolk.spoken_text: The tide in this grotto answers to the Spire. So do we - it promised to send our reef home.
Merfolk.choice_text: The tide in this grotto answers to the Spire. So do we - it promised to send our reef home.

Merfolk Lord.spoken_text: The Spire swore our reef will flow home when the last climber falls. Forgive me - you are in the way.
Merfolk Lord.choice_text: The Spire swore our reef will flow home when the last climber falls. Forgive me - you are in the way.

Nahiri.spoken_text: These stones hold whole worlds in place. Show me you can free yours without shattering the rest.
Nahiri.choice_text: These stones hold whole worlds in place. Show me you can free yours without shattering the rest.

Necromancer.spoken_text: Every fallen climber joins my collection. You would make an exquisite centrepiece.
Necromancer.choice_text: Every fallen climber joins my collection. You would make an exquisite centrepiece.

Niv-Mizzet.spoken_text: Fascinating. Your shard resonates with the Heart. I must study it - you are, regrettably, attached to it.
Niv-Mizzet.choice_text: Fascinating. Your shard resonates with the Heart. I must study it - you are, regrettably, attached to it.

Orthodoxy Angel.spoken_text: I swore to keep this threshold sealed. Your cause may be just; your passage is still forbidden.
Orthodoxy Angel.choice_text: I swore to keep this threshold sealed. Your cause may be just; your passage is still forbidden.

Pyromancer.spoken_text: The Heart Shard burns brighter than any fire. When I hold it, I will never need to bow again.
Pyromancer.choice_text: The Heart Shard burns brighter than any fire. When I hold it, I will never need to bow again.

Skeleton.sound_direction: Old armor scrapes; a spear lowers across the stair.
Skeleton.narrator_caption: An ancient command still binds it to this threshold.
Skeleton.choice_text: Old armor scrapes; a spear lowers across the stair.

Sliver Queen.sound_direction: Layered chitin clicks answer a rising hive hiss.
Sliver Queen.narrator_caption: The hive reads your ascent as a breach in its defenses.
Sliver Queen.choice_text: Layered chitin clicks answer a rising hive hiss.

Sorin.spoken_text: I was promised a path home if this threshold held. I will not lose it now.
Sorin.choice_text: I was promised a path home if this threshold held. I will not lose it now.

Spirit.spoken_text: I followed that promise once. Please, turn back before the Spire takes your name too.
Spirit.choice_text: I followed that promise once. Please, turn back before the Spire takes your name too.

Teferi.spoken_text: I have seen the seal fail. Give me reason to believe your path ends differently.
Teferi.choice_text: I have seen the seal fail. Give me reason to believe your path ends differently.

Vampire.spoken_text: The Spire feeds me, and I feed on climbers. A fair arrangement - for one of us.
Vampire.choice_text: The Spire feeds me, and I feed on climbers. A fair arrangement - for one of us.

Volcano Dragon.spoken_text: The Heart Shard is the greatest treasure in any world. Dragons do not share treasure.
Volcano Dragon.choice_text: The Heart Shard is the greatest treasure in any world. Dragons do not share treasure.

Werewolf.sound_direction: A strained howl breaks into a warning snarl.
Werewolf.narrator_caption: The tower has trapped it between fear and hunger.
Werewolf.choice_text: A strained howl breaks into a warning snarl.

Zombie Lord.spoken_text: Climb, fall, come back... the Spire forgets you. I don't. My army needs commanders.
Zombie Lord.choice_text: Climb, fall, come back... the Spire forgets you. I don't. My army needs commanders.

Zombie Master.spoken_text: The Spire is a graveyard of worlds. I simply keep it tidy. Lie down, commander.
Zombie Master.choice_text: The Spire is a graveyard of worlds. I simply keep it tidy. Lie down, commander.

Wilhelt.choice_text: Rise, my rotting kin. Another climber to join the horde.

Ob Nixilis.choice_text: Every soul on this Spire is a debt. Yours is due.

Gishath.choice_text: [A sun-bright roar shakes the temple steps; the whole herd answers.]

Kozilek.choice_text: [Reality folds around you. The ground forgets which way is down.]

Atraxa.choice_text: Every world bows to the unifier. Kneel, and be made whole.

Heliod.choice_text: Mortals climb, gods judge. Show me you are worth the light.

Iroas.choice_text: Victory belongs to those who charge. Come - the god of war is waiting.

Raptor.sound_direction: Quick clicks in the ferns - then a whole pack of eyes.
Raptor.choice_text: Quick clicks in the ferns - then a whole pack of eyes.

Dragon.sound_direction: A hot gust rolls out of the cave; something inside is counting its gold.
Dragon.choice_text: A hot gust rolls out of the cave; something inside is counting its gold.

Minor Demon.spoken_text: Sign here, climber. Every step after this one is cheaper - for me.
Minor Demon.choice_text: Sign here, climber. Every step after this one is cheaper - for me.

Ghost.spoken_text: These halls were full of music once. Stay. You will learn to hear it.
Ghost.choice_text: These halls were full of music once. Stay. You will learn to hear it.

Demon.spoken_text: The castle fell because someone made me a promise. You look like you keep yours.
Demon.choice_text: The castle fell because someone made me a promise. You look like you keep yours.

Bloodgift Demon.spoken_text: Power always has a price. I only ask for a little blood... to begin with.
Bloodgift Demon.choice_text: Power always has a price. I only ask for a little blood... to begin with.

Eldrazi.sound_direction: The ground ripples like water and grows white, chalky lines.
Eldrazi.choice_text: The ground ripples like water and grows white, chalky lines.

Angel Warrior.spoken_text: The heavens sent us to judge who reaches the top. Show me your resolve.
Angel Warrior.choice_text: The heavens sent us to judge who reaches the top. Show me your resolve.

Sphinx.spoken_text: Answer one question, climber: what will you lose when you win?
Sphinx.choice_text: Answer one question, climber: what will you lose when you win?

Sunmare.sound_direction: A blinding mare paws the shrine floor; the light itself seems to watch you.
Sunmare.narrator_caption: A god's herald bars the way.
Sunmare.choice_text: A blinding mare paws the shrine floor; the light itself seems to watch you.

Eldrazi Floater.sound_direction: A drifting shape hums; the stones around it forget their colour.
Eldrazi Floater.choice_text: A drifting shape hums; the stones around it forget their colour.

Cosmic Horror.sound_direction: The sky splits. Something vast leans through the crack.
Cosmic Horror.choice_text: The sky splits. Something vast leans through the crack.

Criosphinx.spoken_text: The stars have already written how this ends. Shall I read it to you?
Criosphinx.choice_text: The stars have already written how this ends. Shall I read it to you?

Eldrazi Devastator.sound_direction: A towering hulk unfolds; the air bends around its limbs.
Eldrazi Devastator.choice_text: A towering hulk unfolds; the air bends around its limbs.

Fallen Angel.spoken_text: I fell from the high court. I will not let you climb past me.
Fallen Angel.choice_text: I fell from the high court. I will not let you climb past me.
